name: broad_corporate_news
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday September 25, 2026. Scope: Corporate news flow.

Window: Thursday September 24, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET), after-hours that evening, and overnight/pre-market news through Friday September 25, 2026 ~6:00 AM ET.

COVER EVERY ITEM BELOW (run a separate search for each bullet; do not skip one because another was rich)
- Biggest US movers (market cap >= $2B) in the session, after-hours, and pre-market, with the catalyst for each (CNBC / MarketWatch / Barron's / Reuters 'stocks making the biggest moves').
- Earnings after the close or pre-market: EPS and revenue actual vs consensus, guidance old → new.
- Notable analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- M&A (terms, value), contracts with $ size, FDA decisions, SEC filings (8-K, 13D, S-1, offerings), buybacks, executive changes, index adds/deletes, activist stakes.
- Sector threads: AI capex / hyperscaler spend, semis and memory pricing, AI networking and optics, data-center power, software/SaaS; supply-chain reports (Nikkei, DigiTimes, TrendForce).

Prefer primary sources and wire services (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's,
company press releases, SEC EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Fed releases).

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar, or
invent a concise one. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source in parentheses: (Reuters), (company 8-K), (CNBC interview),
  (Morgan Stanley note). "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor].
- Only facts published in the window below. Older background only if it is the direct cause of this
  move, and label it with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **AKAM** — AI Infrastructure
- Akamai announced a **seven-year, $11.6 billion computing-power agreement with Anthropic** on September 24; Anthropic also received a warrant to purchase up to approximately **5% of Akamai’s shares at $111.33 per share**. Akamai rose nearly **20% after hours** and more than **21% pre-market** on September 25. (CNBC)
- The agreement includes a **seven-year power contract** supporting Anthropic’s computing requirements. (CNBC)

## **COST** — Retail / Earnings
- Costco reported fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted EPS of **$6.60**, versus **$6.53 LSEG consensus**, and revenue of **$95.72 billion**, versus **$94.86 billion consensus**, after the September 24 close. (CNBC)
- Costco shares were **marginally higher** in extended trading following the earnings release. (CNBC)

## **SNX** — AI Infrastructure / Distribution
- TD SYNNEX reported fiscal third-quarter EPS of **$5.68**, versus **$4.64 consensus**, and revenue of **$21.6 billion**, versus **$18.79 billion consensus**. (Investing.com)
- TD SYNNEX issued fiscal fourth-quarter EPS guidance of **$5.65–$6.15**, versus **$4.87 consensus**, and revenue guidance of **$21.80–$22.60 billion**, versus **$19.44 billion consensus**. (Investing.com)
- TD SYNNEX declined approximately **9.9%** in pre-market trading on September 25 despite the reported results. (Yahoo Finance)

## **S** — Software & SaaS
- Synopsys gained more than **3% pre-market** after HSBC upgraded the stock from **Hold to Buy**. (CNBC)
- HSBC analyst **Frank Lee** cited Synopsys’s new business model and described the company as a **high-growth AI beneficiary**. (CNBC)

## **NKE** — Consumer / Apparel
- Bank of America downgraded Nike from **Neutral to Underperform** and forecast sales declines from the second quarter through the remainder of fiscal 2027. Nike declined nearly **2% pre-market**. (CNBC)
- The available report did not provide Bank of America’s prior or new price target. (CNBC)

## **SCHL** — Media / Education
- Scholastic reported a fiscal first-quarter adjusted loss of **$3.63 per share**, compared with an adjusted loss of **$2.52 per share** in the year-ago quarter, and revenue of **$216.8 million**, down **4% year over year**. (CNBC)
- Scholastic shares declined more than **10% pre-market** after the report. (CNBC)

## **META** — Internet & Platforms
- Meta shares rose **4.5%** on September 24 after CEO **Mark Zuckerberg** and other executives introduced new AI products at the company’s Connect developer conference. (Investopedia)

## **ORCL** — AI Infrastructure
- Oracle declined **3.5%** on September 24 after Bloomberg reported that the company cited **force majeure** to limit expenses associated with a large data center being built in New Mexico. (Investopedia)
- The report attributed the information to **people familiar with the matter**. **[rumor]** (Investopedia)

## **MGM** — Travel & Leisure
- MGM Resorts International declined **11%** on September 24 and ranked among the largest S&P 500 decliners. (Investopedia)

## **P** — Data Storage
- Everpure forecast fiscal 2028 revenue of **$7.0–$7.3 billion**, compared with analyst expectations of **$5.23 billion**, and operating income of **$1.7–$1.9 billion**, compared with expectations of **$1.09 billion**. (Investopedia)
- Everpure shares rose **18%** on September 24, according to the market report. (Investopedia)
- Everpure affirmed its fiscal 2027 guidance issued during its second-quarter earnings call in August 2026. (Investopedia)

## **SFIX** — Software & SaaS
- Stitch Fix declined approximately **20% pre-market** on September 24 after issuing weaker guidance for the current quarter and fiscal year. (Investopedia)

## **DRI** — Restaurants / Earnings
- Darden Restaurants reported fiscal first-quarter EPS of **$2.05**, matching **$2.05 consensus**, and revenue of **$3.2 billion**, versus **$3.21 billion consensus**. (Investing.com)
- Darden issued fiscal 2027 EPS guidance of **$11.10–$11.35**, versus **$11.28 consensus**. (Investing.com)

## **Viking Therapeutics** — Biotech / Financing
- Viking Therapeutics priced a combined **$500 million financing** consisting of approximately **$275 million of common stock** at **$35.00 per share** and **$225 million of 2.00% convertible senior notes due 2032**. (Zar Newsdesk)
- The equity tranche represented approximately **7.86 million new shares** and settled on **September 25, 2026**. (Zar Newsdesk)
- Viking Therapeutics declined **12.4% pre-market** following the financing. (Zar Newsdesk)

## **DBX** — Software & SaaS
- Citi downgraded Dropbox from **Neutral to Sell** and cut its price target from **$33 to $29**, citing growth concerns related to the company’s AI-driven storage transition. Dropbox declined **5.3% pre-market** to **$32.42**. (Zar Newsdesk)

## **NBIS** — AI Infrastructure
- BNP Paribas upgraded Nebius Group to **Outperform** and raised its price target; the available report did not provide the prior or new target levels. Nebius rose **7.44%**. (Yahoo Finance)

## **FSLR** — Power & Wide-Bandgap
- GLJ Research cut First Solar’s price target to **$250**. First Solar declined **10.32%** and reached a 52-week low of **$172**. (Yahoo Finance; The Company Chronicle)

## **ARM** — Semiconductors
- Arm Holdings declined **7.88%** after renewed focus on SoftBank’s larger margin loan secured by Arm shares. (Yahoo Finance)

## **MU / NVDA / AVGO / SKHY / AMD / SNDK / MRVL / TSM** — Memory & Interconnect
- In September 25 pre-market trading, Micron rose **0.89%**, Nvidia **0.29%**, Broadcom **1.02%**, SK hynix **1.23%**, AMD **1.94%**, SanDisk **1.88%**, Marvell **1.61%**, and Taiwan Semiconductor **0.46%**. (TechFlow)

## Index / Market Calendar — Macro / Calendar
- September 24 was the **third consecutive losing session for the Dow**, according to the market report. (Investopedia)
- Futures before the September 25 session showed S&P 500 futures down **0.05%**, Nasdaq-100 futures marginally higher, and Dow futures up **3 points**, or **0.01%**. (CNBC)

## SEC / Corporate Actions — Corporate Filings
- A September 25 filing compilation listed **28 SEC filings** and reported completion of a **1.71 billion-share buyback at Lloyds Banking Group**. Lloyds is not a US equity issuer, so the item falls outside the requested US-equity scope. (StockTitan)
